intro: Khelden Bremen is a human mage and instructor stationed on the upper floor of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. He oversees the earliest instruction of novice spellcasters who take up the arcane arts in service to Stormwind.

p: Situated within the tranquil stone walls of Northshire Abbey, Khelden Bremen acts as the primary instructor for fledgling human mages. While the clergy and defenders handle martial and spiritual pursuits below, Bremen maintains a quiet study upstairs. Here, he introduces novices to the discipline, focus, and fundamental techniques required to weave raw magical energy safely before they venture out into Elwynn Forest and beyond to Stormwind's Mage Quarter.
